description: 11-subsystem reconstruction manifest and deterministic inventory definition for the earnings-summary research platform.

subsystems.name: Core SQLite Data Layer & Migrations
subsystems.version_ownership: alembic/versions/ migration graph and alembic_version table; verification discovers the active head and requires exactly one head
subsystems.backup_ownership: cron/backup_db.py online SQLite snapshot and execution/restore_drill.py throwaway restore verification; canonical Windows database authority uses WAL mode
invariants: DDL migrations are idempotent and reversible
SQLite WAL mode with PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000
Alembic baseline 0001 wraps DDL in IF NOT EXISTS
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Locally owned SQLite file and Alembic DDL scripts; zero external hosted DB or managed service dependencies

subsystems.name: Deterministic Execution & Orchestration
subsystems.version_ownership: Git commit SHA & execution script CLI parameter specifications
subsystems.backup_ownership: Git version control (code) and ephemeral checkpoint state in .tmp/ (excluded from static backup)
invariants: All scripts use typed CLI arguments and Pydantic models
Outputs >100KB or >2000 lines write to .tmp/
Scripts log JSON-lines to stderr and return data on stdout
Orchestration is resumable via .tmp/ checkpoint state
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Pure Python CLI entrypoints with standard library argparse/typer; independent of proprietary orchestration engines

subsystems.name: Multi-Source Ingestion & Preference Stack
subsystems.version_ownership: Issuer Acquisition Policy hash & source policy versioning
subsystems.backup_ownership: Git version control (code) and immutable source documents in ir_documents/ and transcripts/
invariants: External APIs (FMP, SEC EDGAR, Yahoo) are isolated behind provider circuits
Immutable raw source bytes preserved with accession and SHA-256 locator
Auth credentials passed strictly via environment variables
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Pluggable source adapter interfaces; fallback to local fixture replay or alternative data providers

subsystems.name: Financial Metrics & Valuation Compute Engine
subsystems.version_ownership: Deterministic metric ontology version & valuation model parameter schemas
subsystems.backup_ownership: Git version control (formulas, DCF models, compute code) plus cron/backup_db.py and execution/restore_drill.py for derived database tables
invariants: Zero LLM dependency in deterministic valuation and financial math
Unit and currency checks on every numeric fact before persistence
Reproducible DCF and reverse-DCF valuations from persisted parameters
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Pure deterministic Python compute library with NumPy/Pandas; portable to any runtime environment

subsystems.name: Synthesis Research Lenses & Analysis
subsystems.version_ownership: Playbook revision & research lens template versioning
subsystems.backup_ownership: Git version control (lens logic, report generators) plus cron/backup_db.py and execution/restore_drill.py for research artifacts
invariants: Research lenses cite immutable evidence locators and timestamps
Macro playbook models drawdown regimes deterministically
Advisor briefs generate structured, auditable stance records
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Separation of prompt templates from deterministic evidence assembly; transport-neutral LLM calling

subsystems.name: LLM Transport Router & Downgrade Eval Harness
subsystems.version_ownership: Model ladder configuration version & eval dataset SHA-256 hashes
subsystems.backup_ownership: Git version control (eval cases, grader rubrics, CLI routers) and evals/ test corpus
invariants: Cheapest-at-parity model routing ladder with automated downgrade evals
Per-purpose prompt templates versioned in local repository
Shared quota protection window (03:00-05:00 PT) enforced
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Generic CLI/API transport interface allowing drop-in model provider swaps without business logic changes

subsystems.name: Operations Hub & Provider Circuit Telemetry
subsystems.version_ownership: Governance surface contract version & circuit state schema
subsystems.backup_ownership: Git version control (telemetry renderers) plus cron/backup_db.py and execution/restore_drill.py for provider circuit rows
invariants: Truthful controls: surface reflects actual verifiable subsystem health, never assumed state
Provider circuit states (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN) deterministically managed
Operations surface changes follow directives/operations_governance_surface.md
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Flask HTML fragment endpoints; renders independently of client-side frameworks

subsystems.name: Flask Cockpit Server & Design System
subsystems.version_ownership: Design system token dictionary & CSS custom variable contract
subsystems.backup_ownership: Git version control (server routes, UI templates, design tokens)
invariants: Design token purity: zero raw hex or off-scale typography escapes
Component kit composition via src/ui/controls.py (.k-btn, .k-pill, .k-chip)
Request-scoped SQLite connection pooling via Flask g.request_read_db
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Vanilla HTML/CSS with semantic tokens; no proprietary UI framework runtime locks

subsystems.name: Analyst Memory & Decision Journal Store
subsystems.version_ownership: Journal note schema version & thesis state revision stamps
subsystems.backup_ownership: cron/backup_db.py online SQLite snapshot and execution/restore_drill.py throwaway restore verification for analyst notes and decision tables
invariants: Immutable thesis state history with timestamped analyst notes
Decision records bind to quantitative basis and market price stamps
Journal links preserve bi-directional evidence references
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Relational SQLite tables and plain markdown exports; independent of proprietary agent memory clouds

subsystems.name: Windows Scheduler & Morning Automation
subsystems.version_ownership: Batch script Git versioning & Task Scheduler XML task definitions
subsystems.backup_ownership: Git version control (cron batch scripts, scheduler documentation)
invariants: Wrappers execute via run_python.bat with strict path resolution
Protected LLM quota window respected by scheduled morning pipelines
Task failures write structured error logs to logs/ directory
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Standard Windows Batch / Task Scheduler XML; trivially convertible to cron, systemd, or launchd

subsystems.name: Hermetic Testing & Code Quality Ratchets
subsystems.version_ownership: pyproject.toml tool configurations & requirements.lock pinned dependencies
subsystems.backup_ownership: Git version control (tests, fixtures, lint and type-check configuration)
invariants: Hermetic tests using session-scoped migrated_db fixture
Strict Pyright typechecking and Ruff linting with diff-aware ratchet
Deterministic verification entrypoints runnable offline via pytest
subsystems.exit_ready_boundary: Standard pytest/Ruff/Pyright tooling; runs in any local or CI environment without proprietary runners
